market_summary: Intraday Mon Nov 2, about 11:30am ET: S&P 500 +0.6%, Nasdaq +0.8%, Dow +1.1%, a partial rebound after Friday's chip rout (S&P -1.8%, Nasdaq -2.9%). Crude fell about 7% on Iran ceasefire hopes (Brent near $107), the 10-year eased to about 4.94%, and ISM manufacturing beat at 55.5 with prices paid falling. In Asia the Kospi closed +2.2% on SK hynix (+4.5%), the Hang Seng rose about 0.5%, and the Nikkei slipped 0.3% as Kioxia fell 16%. SOX intraday move not confirmed. Next, AEDT: Apple results 9am Tue; RBA 2:30pm Tue; AMD, Astera and Supermicro Wed morning; US jobs 12:30am Sat.

headlines: Marvell signed an all-stock deal for Lumentum at a 24% premium; Marvell down 9.5% midday, take stays watch.
Partial rebound Monday midday: S&P up 0.6%, Nasdaq up 0.8%; oil down about 7% on Iran ceasefire hopes.
US factory ISM 55.5 beat the 54.6 forecast; production at its highest since November 2021.
Korea October chip exports up 259% on a year ago; SK hynix up 4.5% in Seoul.
Next, AEDT: Apple results 9am Tue, RBA 2:30pm Tue, AMD and Astera Wed morning.
